title: Crushed potatoes and burst tomatoes on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, tomatoes, garlic, spinach, olive oil, bread and chives are all plain home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every item is an everyday Tesco purchase at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: A saucepan, frying pan, colander and toaster or grill are all that is needed, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: 500g potatoes, 300g tomatoes and 100g spinach over four slices of toast makes a sensible breakfast for four, and the boiling and frying times are right.

honest_times.reason: Halving potatoes, slicing garlic, frying tomatoes, crushing and toasting fit in about 15 active minutes, and the 15-minute boil matches the cook time for a quick pace.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: August garden potatoes with burst cherry tomatoes suit the date, and the crushed potatoes are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: Brief, clear British English steps that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes and toast are balanced by tomatoes and spinach, making a filling, real-food breakfast a family would happily eat again.
